issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Jira requested fixing several non-displayable value sets before DSTU publication because publication tooling reported that OperationOutcome could not be cast to ValueSet.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit da32ced84f5bc2a617e32c0a6158d114e24fb18c has the message '$5447 - fix valueset expansion' and git-svn-id @4009, matching the Jira resolution. Its hunks changed the old Java value set expansion client/cache and regenerated obsolete expansion cache artifacts.
additional_context: The old implementation Java paths, bindings.ini, source/vscache, source/terminologies/cache, and the DSTU1 medicationprescription value set file touched by r4009 are absent from the current core checkout. Current source contains no copy of the reported publication-tooling error text. Related broad-search hits were other historical value-set-display issues; FHIR-5256 is already represented on the combined branch and FHIR-3947 was not pursued because it is a separate artifact.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source change is needed because the issue's requested fix was already applied historically and the failing retired cache/tooling surface is not part of the current build.
